how: THE READING OF THE UNMARKED LINES, 2026-11-18. These lines stood under record web-wa3-02, verified; no sorter had marked them, so main had not read them one by one. Main read all 990 such lines of the lane against their records' grounds. Narrowed: line 28: the reflection fixing one sheet, the trivial longitude and the degrees 1, 2, 2 are main's; the formula for phi on the commutator and the meridian's word are the seat's and are not in main's script.
note: The parent's ground is unchanged for its other lines.
